verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.178
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.178

verses.pali: 18. Upāsakavagga
verses.english: 18. A Lay Follower

verses.pali: Rājāsutta
verses.english: Kings

verses.pali: “Taṁ kiṁ maññatha, bhikkhave,
verses.english: “What do you think, mendicants?

verses.pali: api nu tumhehi diṭṭhaṁ vā sutaṁ vā:
verses.english: Have you ever seen or heard

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ puriso pāṇātipātaṁ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratoti.
verses.english: of a person who has given up killing living creatures,

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ rājāno gahetvā pāṇātipātā veramaṇihetu hananti vā bandhanti vā pabbājenti vā yathāpaccayaṁ vā karontī’”ti?
verses.english: and the kings have them arrested for that, and execute, imprison, or banish them, or do what the case requires?”

verses.pali: “No hetaṁ, bhante”.
verses.english: “No, sir.”

verses.pali: “Sādhu, bhikkhave.
verses.english: “Good, mendicants!

verses.pali: Mayāpi kho etaṁ, bhikkhave, neva diṭṭhaṁ na sutaṁ:
verses.english: I too have never seen or heard of such a thing.

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ puriso pāṇātipātaṁ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratoti.
Tamenaṁ rājāno gahetvā pāṇātipātā veramaṇihetu hananti vā bandhanti vā pabbājenti vā yathāpaccayaṁ vā karontī’ti.
Api ca khvassa tatheva pāpakammaṁ pavedenti:
verses.english: Rather, the kings are informed of someone’s bad deed:

verses.pali: ‘ayaṁ puriso itthiṁ vā purisaṁ vā jīvitā voropesīti.
verses.english: ‘This person has murdered a man or a woman.’

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ rājāno gahetvā pāṇātipātahetu hananti vā bandhanti vā pabbājenti vā yathāpaccayaṁ vā karonti.
verses.english: The kings have them arrested for killing, and execute, imprison, or banish them, or do what the case requires.

verses.pali: Api nu tumhehi evarūpaṁ diṭṭhaṁ vā sutaṁ vā’”ti?
verses.english: Have you ever seen or heard of such a case?”

verses.pali: “Diṭṭhañca no, bhante, sutañca suyyissati cā”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, we have seen it and heard of it, and we will hear of it again.”

verses.english: of a person who has given up beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants,

verses.english: Or they had sexual relations with women or maidens under someone else’s protection.
